3.6: Tenderers who meet the above specified minimum qualifying criteria, will only be qualified, if their available tender capacity is more than the total tender value. The available tender capacity will be calculated as under:Assessed Available Tender Capacity: (AxNx2.5-B)Where A-Maximum value of works executed (KPTCL & Non-KPTCL) in any one year during the last five years (updated to FY 2024-2025) taking into account the completed as well as works in progress.

3.7: Even though the Tenderers meet the above criteria, they are subject to be disqualified if they have:- Made misleading or false representations in the forms, statements and attachments submitted in proof of the qualification requirements and/or- Record of poor performance such as abandoning the works, not properly completing the contract, inordinate delays in completion, litigation history, or financial failures etc. and/or- Participated in the previous Tender for the same work and had quoted unreasonably high Tender prices and could not furnish rational justification.

Minimum Average Annual Turnover (MAAT) of the bidder for best two years out of last preceding five financial years ending on March or December as the case may be, shall not be less than Amount put to Tender (APT) as per 3.2(a) of std tender documents(ITT).

technicalCriterionList.description: 3.2 b)For 66/110 kV Terminal bay: Qualifying Requirements(Technical): i) The Bidder should have satisfactorily constructed, completed and commissioned atleast (01) No. of 66kV voltage class or above voltage class Sub-Station /Terminal bay work on Total or Partial Turnkey Basis in the last 10 years preceding the date of bid submission and shall be in satisfactory service for a minimum period of One(1) year prior to the date of submission of the Bid OR The Bidder should have satisfactorily constructed, completeed & commissioned not less than Five(05) of 33kV or above voltage class Sub station/ Terminal bays works on Total turn key/ partial turn key Basis in the last 10 years preceding the date of bid submission and shall be in satisfactory service for a minimum period of One (01) year prior to the date of submission of the Bid. Strenghtening/RE-conductoring of Transmission lines: Bidder should have satisfactorily constructed, completed and commissioned 66kV or above voltage class transmission line commulatively to an extent of atleast 25% of the route lenght(Kms) of transmission line tendered on total/partial turn key basis in the last 10 years preceeding in the date of Bid submission and same shall be in the satisfactory service for a minimum period of 1 year prior to the date of submission of bid.

Earth work excavation for Foundation by mechanical means for all works & depth upto 3 m, as per drawing and technical specifications, including setting out, shoring, strutting, barricading, caution lights, including dressing of excavated surfaces, disposing off or levelling the excavated earth or sorting & stacking the selected earth for reuse in a radius of 50 m and lift upto 1.5 m including cost of labour, tools, usage of machinery & other appurtenaces required to complete the work  
 In all kinds of soils Depth upto 3 m

Providing and laying in position Cement Concrete for levelling course for all works in foundation. The granite/trap/basalt crushed graded coarse aggregates and fine aggregates as per relevant IS Codes machine mixed, laid in layers not exceeding 150 mm thickness, well compacted using plate vibrators, including all lead & lifts, cost of all materials of quality, labour, Usage charges of machinery, curing, and all the other appurtenances required to complete the work as per technical specifications. Mix 1:4:8 Using 40 mm nominal size graded crushed coarse aggregates

Providing and laying in position Cement Concrete for all Foundation works. The granite/trap/basalt crushed graded coarse aggregates and fine aggregates as per relevant IS Codes machine mixed with super plasticizers laid in finished layers, well compacted using needle vibrators, including all lead & lifts, cost of all materials, quality confirming to the requirements of relevant IS codes, labour, Usage charges of machinery, curing, form work, centering & scaffolding  and all the other appurtenances required to complete the work as per technical specifications  
M20 Design Mix Using 20 mm nominal size graded crushed coarse aggregates For foundation add at 3%

Filling available excavated earth (excluding rock) in trenches, plinth, sides of foundations and other similar works etc. in layers not exceeding 20cm in depth, consolidating each deposited layer by ramming and watering, lead up to 50 m and lift upto 1.5 m.
